crossRefs.note: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

translations.web: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;
translations.bsb: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
translations.asv: And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates;
